svg.title: MediaLog, as a DOS text-mode tracker
svg.desc: An olive-gold tracker screen. MediaLog in big pale yellow letters beside its open-book mark; the Song field reads: Everything you've watched, on one timeline, with the verb cycling through read, played and listened to. Four channels, Watched, Read, Played and Listened to, play a life of invented entries from 2016 to today, coloured by kind, with dates, creators, reactions and notes.
